description: Use for "who wins Chiefs vs 49ers" and "what does a -7 spread mean". Pass homeTeam + awayTeam (or game, or one team) to price it off our power ratings, or a spread (home favored negative). Returns win, cover and over/under probability, the projected score and our own total; neutral-site games get no home edge. Free, no key.

awayTeam.description: Away team — same formats as homeTeam (SF, 49ers, San Francisco 49ers). Used with homeTeam.

game.description: Or name the game in one string — "Bills vs Chiefs", "BUF@KC", "Buffalo at Kansas City". The schedule decides which side is home.

homeTeam.description: Home team — abbrev (KC), nickname (Chiefs), full name (Kansas City Chiefs) or city (Kansas City) all work. Auto-derives the spread from PMP power ratings.

spread.description: Point spread from the home team's perspective — home favored is NEGATIVE (e.g. -6.5). Provide this OR homeTeam+awayTeam.

total.description: Game total (over/under points) — this is the LINE you want tested, not our projection. Defaults to the fitted league baseline (NFL_MODEL_CONSTANTS.TOTAL_BASELINE) if omitted. Our own projected total comes back as `model_total` regardless of what you pass here (teams mode only).

name: nfl_win_probability

expected_home_margin.description: Expected home margin in points — positive = home favored.

interpreted_as.description: Which teams the inputs were read as.

spread_home.description: Expected home margin in points — positive = home favored (the input `spread` uses the opposite sign). Same value as expected_home_margin.

tell_user.description: Show this sentence to the user first.

this_week.description: This week's games as { homeTeam, awayTeam } (when no game was named).

title: NFL Win Probability Calculator
